before_times: the length and kind of massage (relaxing, deep tissue, prenatal, hot stones)
a therapist by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
for a teen: the age (13 to 17); a parent or guardian books
away from the studio: what kind of place (a home, a hotel, an office) and the town, before any times
after_time: areas to focus on, and areas to skip
away from the studio: parking, stairs, pets, and a quiet room with space for the table
secure_page_only: the health form: pain or injuries now, recent surgery, pregnancy, blood thinners, heart or blood pressure problems, skin problems, allergies to oils or lotions
a teen's parent: the consent, and staying in the room
a hotel guest: the name the room is booked under, and the room number
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult, for themselves or another adult; a parent or guardian for a teen 13 to 17, who stays in the room (at 16 or 17, where the state's rules allow it, the parent may waive staying in writing on the secure page); no one under 13 (the example studio's setting)

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, sudden numbness or weakness in the legs, loss of bladder or bowel control
stop.say: This could be an emergency. Call 911 now. A massage can wait.

stop.words: a calf that is red, swollen and painful (it can be a blood clot)
stop.say: Please see a doctor today, before any massage.
stop.booking: no booking until a doctor says it's OK

go_on.words: a sunburn, a fresh bruise, a rash or a cut in one area
go_on.what: the therapist skips that area; the massage goes on
the visit moves with no fee

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Health form
steps.when: on the secure page before the first visit (due when booking, inside the saved 10 minutes); a returning client confirms or updates it by the day before (the studio: 6pm; the mobile business: 10am)
steps.goodFor: 12 months, or until the client's health changes
steps.result: most answers change nothing; a flag (blood thinners, a recent surgery, a heart problem) goes to the therapist to read before it books; pregnant: the page offers the prenatal massage instead

steps.name: Therapist's read of a flag
steps.when: before the booking is written, in the therapist's text hours; no answer in 1 hour: Sam, a licensed therapist, reads it
steps.result: OK as booked; OK with a note for the session (lighter pressure, an area skipped); one question on the secure page, like a doctor's OK; or no, with the reason kept private

steps.name: A teen's consent
steps.when: on the secure page, from the parent or guardian who books
steps.result: the parent shows an ID at check-in and stays in the room

first_steps_and_forms.prep: for the reminder: come 10 minutes early; eat lightly; tell the studio on the secure page about any health change; away from the studio: a quiet room with space for the table, pets in another room

staff.skills: Swedish, deep tissue, sports, prenatal, hot stones, chair massage, couples lessons; only therapists trained in prenatal massage are offered for it
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each therapist's own massage license, per state; skin care: an esthetician's license where the state asks
staff.supervision: students work only under a licensed therapist, where the state's rules allow it (none in the example)
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs same-day visits and new clients at the studio; he can set every visit away from the studio to ask him first; a health flag goes to the booked therapist, then to Sam after 1 hour
staff.stand_in: a stand-in must fit what the client asked (a woman, if asked) and the service's skill, and gets the health form and the notes

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult, for themselves or another adult; a parent or guardian for a teen 13 to 17, who stays in the room (at 16 or 17, where the state's rules allow it, the parent may waive staying in writing on the secure page); no one under 13 (the example studio's setting)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a teen's booking texts go only to the parent or guardian; Rosie never texts the teen
children_and_age.minors_rules: a parent's written consent, and a parent in the room, where the state's rules require it

visit.check_in: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk; at a home, hotel or office: the code at the door, from the client who booked
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the therapist; the therapist's notes (pressure, areas, what helped) go in the client's private record
visit.changes_at_visit: an add-on or extra time is priced and OK'd before it's done; the client can ask for lighter pressure, or to stop, at any time
visit.before_work: the therapist goes over the health form, the pressure and the areas with the client in the room before starting; the client undresses alone, to their comfort, and stays covered by a sheet except the area being worked on

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: massage therapy is licensed where the state's rules require it; many states license each therapist, and some cities or states also license the place
license.who: both: each therapist holds their own license, and the studio or company holds a business or place license where the state or city issues one
license.ask: the studio's or company's license number where one is issued; each therapist sends their own number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it
license.background: a background check where the state's form asks for one

never_in_a_text: health answers, pregnancy, injuries, medicines, a doctor's note and the therapist's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record; a hotel room number only on the secure page
